import collections, datetime, hashlib, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/root/embedding-optimizer-v3-experiment/evaluations/dense-primary-v3')
result=subprocess.run(['rg','--files','-g','all-fourteen-tasks-verified.json',str(root)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
rows=[]
for name in result.stdout.splitlines():
    path=Path(name)
    if path.is_symlink() or path.parent.is_symlink() or path.parent.parent != root or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}',path.parent.name):
        raise ValueError('Unexpected checkpoint receipt path')
    raw=path.read_bytes()
    record=json.loads(raw)
    if record['complete_task_files_verified'] is not True or record['plan']['cache_key'] != path.parent.name:
        raise ValueError('Native completion receipt mismatch')
    checkpoint=record['plan']['checkpoint']
    run_id=checkpoint['run_id']
    step=checkpoint['step']
    if not re.fullmatch(r'verified-v3-(adamw|muon|normuon)-[0-9e-]+',run_id) or step not in [782,1563,2345,3126,3907]:
        raise ValueError('Unexpected primary state')
    rows.append({'run_id':run_id,'step':step,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
if len({(row['run_id'],row['step']) for row in rows}) != len(rows):
    raise ValueError('Duplicate state receipts')
print(json.dumps({'scope':'read_only_existing_native_complete_checkpoint_inventory_not_new_numerical_replay','observed_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'complete_checkpoints':len(rows),'counts_by_step':dict(sorted(collections.Counter(row['step'] for row in rows).items())),'receipts':sorted(rows,key=lambda row:(row['step'],row['run_id']))}))
PY
